name: Dream-Anchor Mooring
introDiscord:
Floating anchors hang from nothing.

Dream-Anchor Turtles sleep beneath them while entire dreamscapes drift
from their shells.
introTwitch:
Floating anchors hang from nothing.

Dream-Anchor Turtles sleep beneath them while entire dreamscapes drift
from their shells.

dream-anchor-mooring-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Dream-Anchor Mooring.

left.message:
A sleeping Turtle dreams that you are an intruder.

Unfortunately, dream combat still hurts.

right.message: A treasure chest floats through someone's dream of Moonlit Reef.

forward.message:
A soft dream of Shizuki's old campsite settles around you.

Her note:

'Best sleeping spot in Nexus.

Dreamed Glimmer learned directions.

Obviously unrealistic.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

dream-anchor-mooring-depths.prompt: Deeper within Dream-Anchor Mooring, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: Star Candies sit inside a dream picnic.

right.message: A Dream-Anchor Turtle wakes just enough to object.

forward.message:
One Berry rests under a tiny pillow.

Shizuki wrote:

'Emergency dream snack.

Do not eat while dreaming or you wake up hungry twice.'

dream-anchor-mooring-threshold.prompt: Near Harbor of Unmoored Sleep, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A Dream-Anchor's calm sleep restores you.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A cache floats past inside a dream of somewhere you've never visited.

forward.message: A Turtle pulls its dream back into its shell—and you with it.

bossPromptDiscord:
Every sleeping Turtle wakes simultaneously.

Only one enormous shell remains dreaming.

Use /yes to enter Harbor of Unmoored Sleep or /no to let
the giant nap continue.
bossPromptTwitch:
Every sleeping Turtle wakes simultaneously.

Only one enormous shell remains dreaming.

Use !yes to enter Harbor of Unmoored Sleep or !no to let
the giant nap continue.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Harbor of Unmoored Sleep. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The dream collapses as the enormous Turtle wakes.

Waking Anchorback reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Harbor quiets.

Shizuki's note has somehow gained one new line:

'Good morning~

...wait WHO wrote that?'
